cohort: Ninety-four patients with hereditary antithrombin deficiency (HAD) receiving care at American Thrombosis and Hemostasis Network (ATHN)-affiliated centers were included.
finding: Venous thromboembolism (VTE) was the predominant and frequently recurrent manifestation in patients with HAD, with a trend toward direct oral anticoagulant use and safe administration of low-molecular-weight heparin (LMWH) and antithrombin (AT) concentrate during pregnancy.
